en.title: Background Scene Prompt Builder
en.description: Generate richly detailed, visually consistent background prompts from a rough concept. Multiple prompts will show the same place from different camera angles.

sections.constraints: Inclusions, exclusions, and character-safe background options

concept.label: Concept
concept.placeholder: Example: luxury bedroom with cream tufted headboard, walnut furniture, glass wardrobe, herringbone floor
concept.help: Enter a short idea. For multiple prompts, the system expands it into one locked scene shown from different camera angles.

prompt_count.label: Number of prompts
prompt_count.help: All prompts will describe the same place from different camera angles only. Furniture, fixtures, materials, and layout must stay locked.

language.label: Output language
language.help: Choose the language for the final plain-text prompts.

location_mode.label: Location mode
location_mode.help: Use real-world cues, fictional worldbuilding, or let the system infer.

environment_scope.label: Environment type
environment_scope.help: Interior, exterior, room, street, landscape, cityscape, or auto.

style_genre.label: Style / genre
style_genre.placeholder: cinematic realism, anime background, fantasy, cyberpunk, historical...

time_of_day.label: Time of day
time_of_day.help: The same time of day will be preserved across all prompts.

custom_time_of_day.label: Custom time of day
custom_time_of_day.placeholder: Example: late monsoon afternoon just before sunset

weather_atmosphere.label: Weather / atmosphere
weather_atmosphere.placeholder: misty, humid, rainy, dusty, clear, neon haze...

lighting.primary_light_source.label: Primary light source
lighting.primary_light_source.placeholder: sun through arched windows, moonlight, neon signs, candles...

lighting.light_direction.label: Light direction
lighting.light_direction.placeholder: from camera right, overhead, backlight, through rear windows...

lighting.secondary_light_sources.label: Secondary light sources
lighting.secondary_light_sources.placeholder: reflected water light, small lamps, glowing signage...

camera.camera_profile.label: Camera profile
camera.camera_profile.placeholder: cinematic full-frame, architectural photography, anime background plate...

camera.composition.label: Composition
camera.composition.placeholder: wide establishing, low angle, symmetrical, empty center space...

color_profile.label: Color profile
color_profile.placeholder: warm filmic gold, muted pastel, cool cyan night, earthy naturalism...

consistency_anchors.label: Consistency anchors
consistency_anchors.placeholder: dining table fixed at right foreground, sofa facing wood built-in wall, slim black-framed sliding doors, herringbone oak floor...
consistency_anchors.help: Fixed landmarks, furniture designs, object positions, wall positions, door/window designs, materials, hardware, fixtures, floor patterns, curtains, and built-ins that must appear consistently in every prompt.

must_include.label: Must include
must_include.placeholder: specific locked furniture, table position, door style, architecture, plants, signage...

must_avoid.label: Must avoid
must_avoid.placeholder: people, cars, modern objects, text, logos...

include_people.label: People in background
include_people.help: Main characters are excluded by default because this is for reusable background plates.

custom_character_placement_space.label: Custom character-placement space
custom_character_placement_space.placeholder: Example: leave the lower-right foreground open
